studentized_quantity: Mean completion time; SE=sqrt(a^T unbiased_component_covariance a / 512)
common_random_numbers: Shared indexed draws retained across candidates and cost-only scenarios; within-trajectory cost covariance retained. No cross-candidate covariance or paired-difference SE used. Bonferroni does not require independence.
assumptions: Approximate Student-t/normal mean behavior, finite sample variance and IID completions within a fixed case. Not distribution-free coverage.
relative_regret: Transform marginal time bounds using each fixed numerical model optimum; maximize over regional cases.
